chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa from Sama'ah who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Did any of your ancestors fast in the month of Sha'ban?' He said, 'The best of my ancestors - the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) - fasted it.'

key_terms.آبَاء: Ancestors (referring to the forefathers of the Imams)
key_terms.شَعْبَان: Sha'ban (the eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar)
key_terms.صَامَهُ: He fasted it (referring to the month of Sha'ban)

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad fast in the month of Sha'ban according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) as the 'best of the ancestors' who fasted in Sha'ban, thereby establishing the Prophet's voluntary fasting as the primary precedent for the Imams' practice. This highlights the theological concept of *ittiba'* (following the Prophet) within the Ahl al-Bayt, where the Imams' devotional acts are rooted in the Sunnah of the Prophet, reinforcing the spiritual continuity and authority of the Ahl al-Bayt as inheritors of prophetic tradition.
